description:
As a shopper
  I want to manage items in my cart
  So that I can purchase exactly what I need

elements.name: Add the same item twice increases quantity to 2

steps.name: the demo web app is running
I am on the demo shop home page
I add the first product to the cart
I add the first product to the cart
I go to the cart page
I should see quantity 2 for the first cart item
the subtotal for the first cart item should be the unit price times 2
the cart total should equal the subtotal of all items

elements.name: Increase quantity from the cart page

steps.name: the demo web app is running
I am on the demo shop home page
I add the first product to the cart
I go to the cart page
I increase the quantity of the first cart item to 2
I should see quantity 2 for the first cart item
the subtotal for the first cart item should be the unit price times 2
the cart total should reflect the updated subtotal

elements.name: Remove an item from the cart

steps.name: the demo web app is running
I am on the demo shop home page
I add the first product to the cart
I go to the cart page
I remove the first cart item
the cart should be empty

elements.name: Add two different items and remove one

steps.name: the demo web app is running
I am on the demo shop home page
I add the first product to the cart
I add the second product to the cart
I go to the cart page
I should see 2 items in the cart
I remove the second cart item
I should see 1 item in the cart
the cart total should equal the remaining item subtotal
